[d0122] config | acktracker.enabled | version 4.x
# `acktracker.enabled`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Turns the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed on or off.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `true` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | acktracker |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.enabled` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
enabled = true
```

---

# `acktracker.interval_s`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `30` |
| Available since | 3.0 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | s |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.interval_s` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
interval_s = 30
```

# `acktracker.batch_size`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of messages the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `100` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | messages |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.batch_size` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
batch_size = 100
```

# `acktracker.batch_size` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Number of messages the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed processes together in one batch.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `256` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | acktracker |
| Unit | messages |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `acktracker.batch_size` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml

batch_size = 256
```
